registers.operator: Ministry of Finance of the Czech Republic

free_api.value: Yes. Anyone may use the API if they respect the operating conditions.

key_needed.value: No. A keyless lookup by IČO returned HTTP 200 on our check.

data.value: Search for an economic subject and its public data drawn from the source registers (e.g. name, IČO, registered address).

rate_limit.value: The ministry may restrict users who send more than 500 queries a minute, repeat identical or invalid queries, run many parallel queries, rotate IP addresses or crawl with random data.

licence.value: Open-data catalogue entry: not a copyrighted work, no database right; contains personal data.

registers.register: KRS – Krajowy Rejestr Sądowy (National Court Register)

free_api.value: Yes. The open KRS API launched on 8 Mar 2022 under the 2021 Act on open data and re-use of public-sector information.

api_docs.note: On 17 Oct 2026 this page showed a 'Przerwa techniczna' (technical break) notice.

key_needed.value: No key needed (no key was used on our 15 Oct 2026 check).

data.value: Equivalent of the current and full KRS extract (odpis aktualny / pełny), with GDPR applied; daily and hourly change bulletins.
data.note: Change bulletins: from the API docs page, checked 15 Oct 2026.

rate_limit.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

licence.value: Published under Art. 4b(2) of the KRS Act and the Act of 11 Aug 2021 on open data and re-use of PSI; GDPR applies.

free_api.value: Yes. The API is described as fully open-access.

data.value: Search for companies, associations and public services by name, address, directors or elected officials. Not the full Sirene database; non-diffusible companies and refused RCS registrations are excluded.

rate_limit.value: Max 7 requests/second per IP and 30/second per ASN; HTTP 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

licence.value: Underlying dataset on data.gouv.fr: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0.

registers.register: Finnish Trade Register via the YTJ open-data API

free_api.value: Yes. The data are available free of charge and updated once a day.

key_needed.value: No. A keyless lookup by Business ID returned HTTP 200 on our check.

data.value: Basic details of companies in the Finnish Trade Register; registered notifications since 7 Nov 2014; iXBRL financial statements.

rate_limit.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

licence.value: CC BY 4.0. Mention the source; don't use PRH/YTJ logos or a look-alike layout.

registers.register: Enhetsregisteret – Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities

free_api.value: Yes. Open-data REST API (JSON/HAL) plus nightly bulk downloads (JSON, CSV, XLSX).

key_needed.value: No for the open /api endpoints. Endpoints with personal ID numbers (/autorisert-api) need Maskinporten authentication.

data.value: Entities and sub-entities, roles, corporate group structure, update feeds; bulk files produced every night around 05:00.

rate_limit.value: No request-rate limit stated. Paging is capped: (page+1)×size may not exceed 10,000.

licence.value: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0.

free_api.value: Yes, with credentials: system-to-system Elasticsearch access (user ID + password from cvrselvbetjening@erst.dk), or Datafordeler GraphQL. Price not stated on the pages we read.
free_api.note: Whether access is free of charge: unverified on the official pages we read.

key_needed.value: Yes. Elasticsearch access needs a user ID and password; Datafordeler needs a user plus an API key or OAuth. Only the CVRPerson entity needs an access request.

data.value: CVR company data as JSON documents (Elasticsearch, read-only search); Datafordeler GraphQL entities.

rate_limit.value: No numeric limit stated; access may be temporarily blocked if a solution is not efficient for their Elasticsearch.

licence.note: Datafordeler says CVR follows its general user terms; we have not read those terms yet.

registers.operator: Centre of Registers and Information Systems (RIK)

free_api.value: Yes, after signing a contract with RIK; an API-only contract is free of charge. Daily open-data files are also free to download.

key_needed.value: Yes. A signed contract; REST services use an API key (/keyLogin/), XML services a username and password. Autocomplete and e-invoice-recipient queries need no contract.

data.value: Eight open-data datasets (JSON/XML, some CSV), updated daily; API: general and detailed company data, annual reports, beneficial owners, representation rights and more. Since 1 Nov 2024 open-data files exclude personal ID codes.

rate_limit.value: 50,000 answers/day and 1 simultaneous query per contract partner; 20 requests/minute per IP for document downloads.

licence.value: Downloading requires accepting the licence terms; the site's licence link points to CC BY 4.0.

free_api.value: Partly. Open Dataset APIs (basic company data, annual accounts) are free with no subscription. The main APIs cost €6.40 a month per API key plus €0.02 per query (Zoeken is free).

key_needed.value: Yes. Open Datasets use a public API key; the paid APIs need a subscription key.

data.value: Open Dataset: basic company data (basisbedrijfsgegevens) and annual accounts (jaarrekeningen) by KVK number, for listed legal forms such as BV, NV, CV, VOF. Paid: search, basic profile, branch profile, names, change service.

rate_limit.value: Open Dataset APIs: 1 query per minute (separate from other API limits). Our checker received HTTP 429 when calling twice.

licence.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

free_api.value: Yes. Public Search, the Open Data file and the Public Search web services are free. The extended reuse file is paid (€30,000/year for commercial use).

api_docs.note: Technical details are in the KBO Open Data cookbook (PDF) linked from this page.

key_needed.value: Open Data: you must register and accept the licence; SFTP access needs a request to kbo-bce-webservice@economie.fgov.be. Web-service access procedure: not stated on the pages we read.

data.value: Daily CSV of active registered entities and establishment units (full file + update file, each kept 31 days).

rate_limit.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

licence.value: KBO Open Data licence; personal data may not be reused for direct marketing.

free_api.note: No official API documented on the portal or the ministry page we checked. Retrieval via the portal has been free since 1 Aug 2022.

api_docs.note: No API documentation found on the official pages we checked.

key_needed.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

data.value: Commercial, cooperative, partnership, company and association registers of all federal states, plus register announcements; register documents (e.g. articles) can be retrieved free since 1 Aug 2022.

rate_limit.note: Third-party sources cite a per-hour retrieval cap; we could not confirm it on an official page. The portal itself warns of overload-related outages.

licence.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

registers.operator: Federal Ministry of Justice (BMJ), via JustizOnline

free_api.value: Yes for High Value Datasets: since January 2025 Firmenbuch HVD data are free via IWG interfaces, after application and approval.

api_docs.note: The web-service interface description is a ZIP download on this page.

key_needed.value: Yes. Apply for IWG interface access; downloads need ID Austria or another EU eID and acceptance of the terms of use.

data.value: Company data per Annex 5 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/138 (HVD), plus the authorised representative bodies (Directive (EU) 2019/1151).

rate_limit.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

licence.value: Agreement under § 6(3)(3) with § 10 IWG (Austrian re-use act), PDF on the ministry page.

registers.register: BORME – Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil (official gazette of the commercial register)
registers.operator: Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado (AEBOE)

free_api.value: Yes. Open-data API for the daily BORME summary (sumario) by date, in XML or JSON.
free_api.note: BORME publishes registered company acts; it is not a company-extract API. Extracts from the Registro Mercantil are a separate service (not covered here).

key_needed.value: No. A keyless request for a date returned HTTP 200 JSON on our check.

data.value: Daily BORME summary: sections (e.g. Section A 'Empresarios. Actos inscritos') with items per province, each linking to PDF, HTML and XML versions of the published acts.

rate_limit.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

licence.value: BOE re-use conditions (standard licence approved by AEBOE resolution of 27 Jun 2024); reuse implies accepting them, with source attribution.

free_api.value: Yes. Public REST endpoints: check-vat-number, check-vat-test-service and check-status.

key_needed.value: No. check-status answered without a key on our check.

data.value: Whether a VAT number is valid, plus name/address where the member state provides them; per-country service availability.

rate_limit.value: No numeric limit; DG TAXUD blocks abusive IPs (e.g. the same number many times a day, many invalid numbers).

licence.value: For confirming VAT IDs for intra-Community supplies; any other use or extraction is strictly forbidden.

registers.register: BRIS – Business Registers Interconnection System ('Find a company' on e-Justice)

free_api.note: No public API documented on the portal page we checked.

key_needed.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

data.value: Search across the interconnected business registers of all EU countries (interconnected since June 2017).

rate_limit.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

licence.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

registers.operator: Federal Office of Justice, Federal Registry of Commerce (EHRA)

free_api.value: REST API offered alongside the web app; access on request via zefix@bj.admin.ch. Whether it is free of charge is not stated on the page we read.

key_needed.value: Yes. Endpoints require credentials (our unauthenticated call got HTTP 401).

data.value: Single queries on the daily-updated central business name index (company search, by UID/CH-ID/EHRA-ID, SOGC publications, legal forms). No subscriptions or full-database downloads; core data of active entities is on opendata.swiss.

rate_limit.note: Not stated on the official pages we checked.

licence.value: “OGD Open use. Must provide the source.” (opendata.swiss terms).
